description: This Java source file defines a custom layout class 'CardLayout' that extends RelativeLayout. It provides specialized touch event handling to support swipe interactions, with internal state management for swipe detection. The class is part of the 'com.example.android.batchstepsensor.cardstream' package and is used to create UI elements with customized touch effects.
